segments.name: Expedited Freight
segments.description: Provides expedited regional, inter-regional and national LTL and truckload services to freight forwarders, third-party logistics companies, airlines and shippers.
segments.evidence: Our Expedited Freight segment provides expedited regional, inter-regional and national LTL services.

segments.name: Omni Logistics
products: air and ocean freight consolidation and forwarding
segments.description: Provides asset-light global freight forwarding, contract logistics and value-added warehousing to United States-based customers in high-growth end markets.
segments.evidence: Our Omni Logistics segment provides a full suite of global logistics services.

segments.name: Intermodal
segments.description: Provides first- and last-mile container drayage, dedicated contract and warehouse handling services at seaports and railheads.
segments.evidence: Our Intermodal segment provides first- and last-mile high value intermodal container drayage services both to and from seaports and railheads.

revenueModel.text: Freight forwarders, third-party logistics companies, airlines and shippers pay us for LTL, truckload, forwarding and drayage services.
revenueModel.evidence: We market our Expedited Freight services primarily to freight and logistics intermediaries (such as freight forwarders and third-party logistics companies), and airlines (such as integrated air cargo carriers, and passenger and cargo airlines).

changes.text: In 2024 the company added the Omni Logistics reportable segment through the Omni Acquisition.
changes.evidence: On January 25, 2024, we completed the Omni Acquisition, which has allowed us to expand our operations both domestically and internationally.
